# GEOwallah

> GEOwallah is an AI-search optimization agency based in Barrackpore, West Bengal, India, serving businesses across India. We make a business the answer customers see and the brand AI engines recommend — across Google Search, Google Maps / local pack, and generative engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot). Services span GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), SEO & AI SEO, Local SEO / Google Business Profile, website & store development, content, citations, and digital marketing.

GEOwallah's core promise: leads over vanity metrics, presence everywhere customers search (classic + AI), and total transparency. Contact: rankme@geowallah.com · WhatsApp +91 7003888936.
